name: TikTok Shop Seller
description: Let your AI work with your TikTok shop: orders with buyer notes and addresses, products, stock, warehouses, shipping labels and tracking, returns and settlements, with shipping, product, stock and price changes available on request.
instructions:
## TikTok Shop Seller
This connector calls the **TikTok Shop Open API** (Partner Center, versioned paths such as `/order/202309/...`) for one TikTok shop: orders and their price detail, products, categories, brands and stock, warehouses, carriers, packages, shipping labels and tracking, returns, cancellations and settlements. Writes (shipping, product changes, stock and price) are included but installed switched off.

**What you need**: an app of your own in the TikTok Shop Partner Center with its **App key**, **App secret** and **Service ID**, and the shop owner's Seller Center account. TikTok only lets a seller register as a **seller developer** (and create an app for their own shop) when the shop has an **assigned account manager**; without one, Partner Center answers "This account is not eligible for seller developer registration". In that case ask TikTok Shop for an account manager eligibility review in the Seller Center Help Center, or use an app of a developer who has one. About 15 minutes once the app exists.

**Setup**
1. Sign in at https://partner.tiktokshop.com (US shops: https://partner.us.tiktokshop.com) with the shop owner account, open **App & Service** and create a custom app for your shop. Under **Manage API**, enable the scopes the tools need: Shop authorized information, Order information, Product basic and Product write, Fulfillment basic, Logistics basic, Return and refund basic, Finance information.
2. Set the app's **Redirect URL** to `<your AnythingMCP address>/api/tiktok-shop/callback`: on AnythingMCP Cloud `https://cloud.anythingmcp.com/api/tiktok-shop/callback`, when self-hosted your own `SERVER_URL` followed by `/api/tiktok-shop/callback`.
3. Copy the app's **App key** into `TIKTOK_SHOP_APP_KEY`, its **App secret** into `TIKTOK_SHOP_APP_SECRET` and its **Service ID** (App & Service, the app, Basic Information) into `TIKTOK_SHOP_SERVICE_ID`. For a US shop set `TIKTOK_SHOP_MARKET` to `US`; leave it empty for the UK, the EU and every other market.
4. Install the connector, open it in AnythingMCP and click **Authorize with Provider**. TikTok Shop asks you to pick the region, sign in to Seller Center and approve the app; you come back to AnythingMCP and the connector is ready. If the authorization covers several shops (cross-border sellers), the connector uses the one named in `TIKTOK_SHOP_SHOP_ID` (shop id, shop code or exact name; set it before you authorize), else the first one. `tiktok_shop_get_authorized_shops` lists them.

Cloud and self-hosted work the same way: the connector always uses your own app.

**How it signs**: every call carries `app_key`, `timestamp` and `sign` in the query, and the shop's `shop_cipher` where TikTok asks for it. `sign` is an HMAC-SHA256, keyed with the app secret, over the path, the sorted query parameters and the JSON body, wrapped in the app secret. The access token goes in the `x-tts-access-token` header. The app secret never leaves AnythingMCP. A timestamp more than 5 minutes old is refused, so a host clock that is off gives a timestamp error.

**Tokens**: the access token lasts 7 days and is renewed automatically before it expires; the refresh token lasts as long as the seller's authorization and is stored encrypted on the connector. When the authorization expires or the seller cancels it (Seller Center, App Store, My apps and incidents), TikTok refuses the refresh token: the connector then shows that it needs a new authorization, its owner gets one email, and calls stop until someone clicks **Authorize with Provider** again.

**Where to start**: `tiktok_shop_get_authorized_shops` checks the connection. Orders: `tiktok_shop_search_orders` (filters by status and time, returns full orders), `tiktok_shop_get_orders` for up to 50 order ids, `tiktok_shop_get_order_price_detail` for the money. Fulfilment: an order's `packages` give package ids; `tiktok_shop_get_package`, `tiktok_shop_get_shipping_document` (label or packing slip to print), `tiktok_shop_get_order_tracking`. For orders you ship yourself, `tiktok_shop_list_warehouses`, `tiktok_shop_get_delivery_options` and `tiktok_shop_get_shipping_providers` give the carrier id for tracking. Products: `tiktok_shop_search_products`, `tiktok_shop_get_product`, `tiktok_shop_get_inventory`. New products: `tiktok_shop_recommend_category`, `tiktok_shop_get_category_attributes`, `tiktok_shop_get_category_rules`, `tiktok_shop_get_brands`, `tiktok_shop_upload_product_image`, then `tiktok_shop_create_product`. After-sales: `tiktok_shop_search_returns`, `tiktok_shop_search_cancellations`. Money: `tiktok_shop_get_statements`, `tiktok_shop_get_order_transactions`.

**Ids, times and paging**: ids are long numbers; always pass them as strings. Times are Unix seconds. Lists page with `page_token`: pass `next_page_token` from the previous answer while it is not empty.

**Errors**: TikTok answers with a `code` (0 is success) and a `message`. `106001`: the signature is wrong, so `TIKTOK_SHOP_APP_KEY` and `TIKTOK_SHOP_APP_SECRET` do not belong together. `36009004` names what is invalid: the app key, the access token header or the timestamp. `105002`: the access token expired; the connector renews it and retries once. `105005`: the app or the authorization lacks the scope for that API: enable it in Partner Center (Manage API) and authorize again. `106013`: no shop cipher; authorize again. `36009033`: the app has an IP allow list that does not include AnythingMCP's address. `36009002` or HTTP 429: rate limit, wait and try again.

**Writes**: `tiktok_shop_ship_package`, `tiktok_shop_mark_package_shipped`, `tiktok_shop_update_order_shipping_info`, `tiktok_shop_create_product`, `tiktok_shop_edit_product`, `tiktok_shop_partial_edit_product`, `tiktok_shop_update_inventory`, `tiktok_shop_update_price`, `tiktok_shop_activate_products` and `tiktok_shop_deactivate_products` change the live shop or what buyers see and are installed switched off; turn on the ones you need per connector, and confirm every change with the user first. `tiktok_shop_upload_product_image` only stores an image for later use. Nothing here moves money, cancels orders or answers buyers.
prerequisites: A TikTok Shop Partner Center app of your own (App key, App secret, Service ID) whose Redirect URL is your AnythingMCP address followed by /api/tiktok-shop/callback, and the shop owner's Seller Center account. TikTok only lets sellers with an assigned account manager register as seller developers. About 15 minutes once the app exists.

TIKTOK_SHOP_APP_KEY.label: App key
TIKTOK_SHOP_APP_KEY.help: Partner Center, App & Service, your app: the App key.
TIKTOK_SHOP_APP_KEY.patternMessage: Paste the App key alone: letters and digits, without spaces or quotes.

TIKTOK_SHOP_APP_SECRET.label: App secret
TIKTOK_SHOP_APP_SECRET.help: Same page as the App key: the App secret. It signs every request and is never sent.
TIKTOK_SHOP_APP_SECRET.patternMessage: Paste the App secret alone: letters and digits, without spaces or quotes.

TIKTOK_SHOP_SERVICE_ID.label: Service ID
TIKTOK_SHOP_SERVICE_ID.help: Partner Center, App & Service, your app, Basic Information: the Service ID. The authorization link is built from it.
TIKTOK_SHOP_SERVICE_ID.patternMessage: Paste the Service ID alone, without spaces.

TIKTOK_SHOP_MARKET.label: Market
TIKTOK_SHOP_MARKET.help: US for a US shop (it authorizes on TikTok Shop's US site). Leave empty for the UK, the EU and every other market.
TIKTOK_SHOP_MARKET.patternMessage: Use US, or leave it empty.

TIKTOK_SHOP_SHOP_ID.label: Shop (optional)
TIKTOK_SHOP_SHOP_ID.help: Only when one authorization covers several shops: the shop id, shop code or exact shop name to use. Set it before you authorize. Empty uses the first shop.

instructionFacts: This connector is set to work with the shop {{TIKTOK_SHOP_SHOP_ID}} (TIKTOK_SHOP_SHOP_ID) when the authorization covers several shops.
This connector's shop market is set to {{TIKTOK_SHOP_MARKET}} (TIKTOK_SHOP_MARKET); US shops authorize on TikTok Shop's US site.

verifyHints.401: TikTok Shop refused the signature or the shop authorization. Check that TIKTOK_SHOP_APP_KEY and TIKTOK_SHOP_APP_SECRET belong to the same app, then click Authorize with Provider again.
verifyHints.403: TikTok Shop refused this API: enable its scope for your app in Partner Center (Manage API) and authorize again, or remove the IP allow list of the app.
verifyHints.429: TikTok Shop is rate limiting this app. Wait a minute and try again.

tools.name: tiktok_shop_get_authorized_shops
tools.description: List the shops this connector's authorization covers: id, name, region (GB, US, DE...), seller type and shop code. Start here to check the connection. The connector uses one of them (TIKTOK_SHOP_SHOP_ID, else the first).

tools.name: tiktok_shop_search_orders
tools.description: Search the shop's orders, newest first, up to 100 per page, filtered by status, creation or update time, shipping type or buyer. Returns full orders (line items, buyer message, recipient address, packages). Page with page_token while next_page_token is set.

create_time_ge.description: Created at or after. Unix time in seconds.

create_time_lt.description: Created before. Unix time in seconds.

update_time_ge.description: Updated at or after. Unix time in seconds.

update_time_lt.description: Updated before. Unix time in seconds.

shipping_type.description: TIKTOK (TikTok shipping label) or SELLER (you ship, own carrier).

is_buyer_request_cancel.description: Only orders whose buyer asked to cancel.

page_token.description: Leave out for the first page; then next_page_token from the previous answer.

tools.name: tiktok_shop_get_orders
tools.description: Read up to 50 orders by id: status, line items (product, SKU id, seller SKU, variant name, price), buyer message and seller note, recipient name, phone and address, payment totals, shipping provider, tracking number and packages.

tools.name: tiktok_shop_get_order_price_detail
tools.description: Price breakdown of one order: subtotal, shipping fee, seller and platform discounts, taxes, and what the buyer paid, per order and per line item.

tools.name: tiktok_shop_search_products
tools.description: Search the shop's products, up to 100 per page, by status, seller SKU, SKU id, or creation or update time. Returns product id, title, status and SKUs with price and stock. Page with page_token while next_page_token is set.

seller_skus.description: Only products with these seller SKU codes.

sku_ids.description: Only products with these SKU ids (up to 10).

create_time_ge.description: Created at or after. Unix time in seconds.

create_time_le.description: Created at or before. Unix time in seconds.

update_time_ge.description: Updated at or after. Unix time in seconds.

update_time_le.description: Updated at or before. Unix time in seconds.

category_version.description: Category tree: v1 (3 levels, every market except the US) or v2 (7 levels, US). Default: the shop's tree.

page_token.description: Leave out for the first page; then next_page_token from the previous answer.

tools.name: tiktok_shop_get_product
tools.description: Read one product in full: title, description, category, brand, images (with their uri, reusable when creating or editing), attributes, package size and weight, audit status, and every SKU with seller SKU, variant attributes, price and stock per warehouse.

return_under_review_version.description: For a live product sent back to review after an edit: true returns the version under review, false (default) the live one.

locale.description: BCP-47 locale for category and attribute names, e.g. en-GB, de-DE, en-US. Default: the shop's locale.

tools.name: tiktok_shop_get_inventory
tools.description: Stock of up to 100 products or 600 SKUs: available quantity per SKU and per warehouse. If both lists are given, sku_ids wins.

tools.name: tiktok_shop_recommend_category
tools.description: Suggest the leaf category for a new product from its title (and optionally description and images). Returns the category path with ids; use the leaf id in tiktok_shop_create_product.

items.description: An image already uploaded with tiktok_shop_upload_product_image.

category_version.description: Category tree: v1 (3 levels, every market except the US) or v2 (7 levels, US). Default: the shop's tree.

locale.description: BCP-47 locale for category and attribute names, e.g. en-GB, de-DE, en-US. Default: the shop's locale.

tools.name: tiktok_shop_get_categories
tools.description: The categories this shop may list in, with id, parent id, name, whether it is a leaf and its permission status. Filter with keyword. Products go in leaf categories only.

keyword.description: Only categories whose name contains this word.

category_version.description: Category tree: v1 (3 levels, every market except the US) or v2 (7 levels, US). Default: the shop's tree.

locale.description: BCP-47 locale for category and attribute names, e.g. en-GB, de-DE, en-US. Default: the shop's locale.

tools.name: tiktok_shop_get_category_attributes
tools.description: The attributes of a leaf category: product attributes (material, country of origin...) and sales attributes (colour, size), with their value lists and which ones are mandatory.

category_version.description: Category tree: v1 (3 levels, every market except the US) or v2 (7 levels, US). Default: the shop's tree.

locale.description: BCP-47 locale for category and attribute names, e.g. en-GB, de-DE, en-US. Default: the shop's locale.

tools.name: tiktok_shop_get_category_rules
tools.description: The listing rules of a leaf category: required certifications, size chart, package dimensions, product identifier codes and cash on delivery.

category_version.description: Category tree: v1 (3 levels, every market except the US) or v2 (7 levels, US). Default: the shop's tree.

locale.description: BCP-47 locale for category and attribute names, e.g. en-GB, de-DE, en-US. Default: the shop's locale.

tools.name: tiktok_shop_get_brands
tools.description: Brands available to the shop, optionally for one category and by name prefix, with whether the shop is authorized to sell them.

category_id.description: Only brands available in this category.

brand_name.description: Only brands whose name starts with this text.

is_authorized.description: Only brands the shop is authorized to sell.

category_version.description: Category tree: v1 (3 levels, every market except the US) or v2 (7 levels, US). Default: the shop's tree.

page_token.description: Leave out for the first page; then next_page_token from the previous answer.

tools.name: tiktok_shop_list_warehouses
tools.description: The shop's warehouses (sales and return), with id, name, address, type and whether one is the default. Warehouse ids are needed for stock updates and new SKUs.

tools.name: tiktok_shop_get_delivery_options
tools.description: The delivery options of a warehouse (standard, express...), with their ids and limits. Use an id with tiktok_shop_get_shipping_providers.

tools.name: tiktok_shop_get_shipping_providers
tools.description: The carriers of a delivery option, with the shipping_provider_id that tracking updates need (Royal Mail, Evri, DPD and so on in the UK).

delivery_option_id.description: Delivery option id from tiktok_shop_get_delivery_options, or from an order (delivery_option_id).

tools.name: tiktok_shop_search_packages
tools.description: Search packages, up to 50 per page, by status and creation or update time: package id, order ids, status, carrier and tracking number. Page with page_token.

create_time_ge.description: Created at or after. Unix time in seconds.

create_time_lt.description: Created before. Unix time in seconds.

update_time_ge.description: Updated at or after. Unix time in seconds.

update_time_lt.description: Updated before. Unix time in seconds.

page_token.description: Leave out for the first page; then next_page_token from the previous answer.

sort_field.description: Sort by create_time, update_time or order_pay_time.

tools.name: tiktok_shop_get_package
tools.description: Read one package: orders and line items in it, status, delivery option (SEND_BY_SELLER means you ship and add tracking yourself), carrier, tracking number, handover method and pickup slot.

package_id.description: Package id (from an order's packages, or tiktok_shop_search_packages).

tools.name: tiktok_shop_get_package_handover_time_slots
tools.description: Pickup and drop-off options for a package that ships with a TikTok shipping label: available pickup slots and whether drop-off is possible. Use before tiktok_shop_ship_package.

tools.name: tiktok_shop_get_shipping_document
tools.description: Get a download link for a package's shipping label, packing slip or both (PDF, A6 or A5; or the label as PNG), to print. The link expires after a while: fetch a new one rather than storing it.

document_type.description: SHIPPING_LABEL, PACKING_SLIP, SHIPPING_LABEL_AND_PACKING_SLIP, SHIPPING_LABEL_PICTURE (PNG) or HAZMAT_LABEL.

document_size.description: A6 (default) or A5, for PDF documents.

tools.name: tiktok_shop_get_order_tracking
tools.description: The carrier's tracking events of an order's shipment, newest first, with time and description.

tools.name: tiktok_shop_search_returns
tools.description: Search return and refund requests by order, status, type or time, 10 to 50 per page: return id, order, type (REFUND, RETURN_AND_REFUND, REPLACEMENT), status, reason, amounts and items.

return_status.description: Statuses, e.g. RETURN_OR_REFUND_REQUEST_PENDING, AWAITING_BUYER_SHIP, BUYER_SHIPPED_ITEM, REFUND_OR_RETURN_REQUEST_REJECT, RETURN_OR_REFUND_REQUEST_SUCCESS, RETURN_OR_REFUND_REQUEST_CANCEL, RETURN_OR_REFUND_REQUEST_COMPLETE.

create_time_ge.description: Created at or after. Unix time in seconds.

create_time_lt.description: Created before. Unix time in seconds.

update_time_ge.description: Updated at or after. Unix time in seconds.

update_time_lt.description: Updated before. Unix time in seconds.

page_token.description: Leave out for the first page; then next_page_token from the previous answer.

tools.name: tiktok_shop_search_cancellations
tools.description: Search order cancellation requests by order, status or time: cancel id, order, who asked, reason, status and items.

cancel_status.description: Statuses, e.g. CANCELLATION_REQUEST_PENDING, CANCELLATION_REQUEST_SUCCESS, CANCELLATION_REQUEST_CANCEL, CANCELLATION_REQUEST_COMPLETE.

create_time_ge.description: Created at or after. Unix time in seconds.

create_time_lt.description: Created before. Unix time in seconds.

update_time_ge.description: Updated at or after. Unix time in seconds.

update_time_lt.description: Updated before. Unix time in seconds.

page_token.description: Leave out for the first page; then next_page_token from the previous answer.

tools.name: tiktok_shop_get_statements
tools.description: The shop's settlement statements (daily payouts), with revenue, fees, adjustments, settlement amount and payment status, in a time window.

statement_time_ge.description: Generated at or after. Unix time in seconds.

statement_time_lt.description: Generated before. Unix time in seconds.

page_token.description: Leave out for the first page; then next_page_token from the previous answer.

tools.name: tiktok_shop_get_order_transactions
tools.description: The settlement of one order: revenue, each fee and commission, shipping costs, taxes and the amount settled to the seller.

tools.name: tiktok_shop_upload_product_image
tools.description: Upload an image to TikTok Shop from a public link, for use in a product (gallery, variant, description, size chart or certification). Returns the image uri to pass to tiktok_shop_create_product or the edit tools. JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC or BMP, up to 10 MB; gallery images 300 to 4000 px a side. Does not change any listing on its own.

image_url.description: Public HTTPS link to the image.

use_case.description: What the image is for, default MAIN_IMAGE.

tools.name: tiktok_shop_ship_package
tools.description: Arrange shipment of a package. With a TikTok shipping label: choose PICKUP (with a slot from tiktok_shop_get_package_handover_time_slots) or DROP_OFF. When you ship yourself (delivery option SEND_BY_SELLER): pass self_shipment with tracking number and shipping_provider_id; the buyer sees it. Installed switched off. Confirm with the user first.

tools.name: tiktok_shop_mark_package_shipped
tools.description: Mark an order (or some of its line items) as shipped with your own carrier and send the tracking number to the buyer: for orders you ship yourself (shipping type SELLER). Creates the package. Installed switched off. Confirm the order, items, carrier and tracking number with the user first.

tracking_number.description: Carrier tracking number, 4 to 50 letters, digits, hyphens, underscores or dots.

order_line_list.description: Only these line items; leave out to ship the whole order.

order_line_id.description: Line item id (line_items[].id of the order).

sub_item_id.description: For bundle products only: the sub-item id.

tools.name: tiktok_shop_update_order_shipping_info
tools.description: Correct the tracking number or carrier of an order already marked as shipped (shipping type SELLER). The buyer sees the change. Installed switched off. Confirm with the user first.

tools.name: tiktok_shop_create_product
tools.description: Create a product, listed after TikTok's review or kept as a draft (save_mode AS_DRAFT). Needs a leaf category, gallery images uploaded with tiktok_shop_upload_product_image, the SKUs with price and stock per warehouse, and the mandatory attributes of the category (tiktok_shop_get_category_attributes, tiktok_shop_get_category_rules). Returns the product and SKU ids. Installed switched off. Show the user the full product first and confirm.

description.description: Description in HTML (p, img, ul, ol, li, br, strong, b, i, em, u, h1 to h4, table). Images inside must be uploaded with use_case DESCRIPTION_IMAGE.

category_version.description: Category tree: v1 (3 levels, every market except the US) or v2 (7 levels, US). Default: the shop's tree.

brand_id.description: Brand id from tiktok_shop_get_brands; leave out for no brand.

main_images.description: Gallery images, the first is the cover; up to 9.

items.description: An image already uploaded with tiktok_shop_upload_product_image.

id.description: SKU id, only when editing an existing SKU (from tiktok_shop_get_product).

sales_attributes.description: Variant attributes of this SKU, e.g. Colour: Red. Use a built-in attribute id from tiktok_shop_get_category_attributes, or a custom name and value_name.

sku_img.description: An image already uploaded with tiktok_shop_upload_product_image.

amount.description: Local display price before discounts, as a decimal string, e.g. "12.99" (global sellers: the pre-tax price).

currency.description: Currency: GBP (UK), EUR, USD and so on.

sale_price.description: Global sellers only: the display price shown on the product page.

inventory.description: Stock per warehouse (tiktok_shop_list_warehouses). List every warehouse the SKU is stored in.

quantity.description: Units in stock that can ship now, 1 to 99,999.

external_sku_id.description: Id of this SKU in another system of yours.

product_attributes.description: Product attributes from tiktok_shop_get_category_attributes (brand-independent facts such as material). Mandatory ones depend on the category.

values.description: Values: a built-in value id, or a custom name.

value.description: Weight as a decimal string, e.g. "0.25".

is_cod_allowed.description: Offer cash on delivery, where the market supports it.

external_product_id.description: Id of this product in another system of yours.

save_mode.description: LISTING (submit for review and list, default) or AS_DRAFT (keep as a draft).

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string; repeating a request with the same key does not create a second product.

external_product_id.description: Id of this product in another system of yours.

save_mode.description: LISTING (submit for review and list, default) or AS_DRAFT (keep as a draft).

tools.name: tiktok_shop_update_inventory
tools.description: Set the stock of one or more SKUs of a product, per warehouse. Overwrites the current figure and goes live at once. List every warehouse the SKU is stored in. Installed switched off. Confirm product, SKU, warehouse and new quantity with the user first.

skus.description: SKUs of this product with their new stock.

inventory.description: Stock per warehouse (tiktok_shop_list_warehouses). List every warehouse the SKU is stored in.

quantity.description: Units in stock that can ship now, 1 to 99,999.

tools.name: tiktok_shop_update_price
tools.description: Set the price of one or more SKUs of an active product. Goes live at once; it does not go through product review. Installed switched off. Confirm product, SKU and new price with the user first.

skus.description: SKUs of this product with their new price.

amount.description: Local display price before discounts, as a decimal string, e.g. "12.99" (global sellers: the pre-tax price).

currency.description: Currency: GBP (UK), EUR, USD and so on.

sale_price.description: Global sellers only: the display price shown on the product page.

tools.name: tiktok_shop_activate_products
tools.description: Put deactivated products back on sale (they may go through review again). Installed switched off. Confirm the products with the user first.

tools.name: tiktok_shop_deactivate_products
tools.description: Take products off sale: buyers can no longer see or order them until they are activated again. Installed switched off. Confirm the products with the user first.
